scores.evidence: All three objectives are can-do statements, and each has 2 or more questions with objectiveId: o1 has q0, q1, q2, e1 and e2; o2 has q3, e3 and e4 (apply); o3 has q4, e5 and e6. One gap: o3 is a create objective (「設計できる」), but every o3 question asks the learner to analyze or choose. Only the ungraded practice-audit asks the learner to write the prompt.

hook-b1 sets a concrete problem in 3 sentences (「機能の実装を任せている途中で、急ぎのバグ修正…」「毎晩、テストの失敗を報告してほしい」), and the problem leads into o1–o3. hook-predict q0 is an ungraded prediction, and its wrong options carry the brief's misconception 1. There is no trivia or statistic.

The prerequisites list 第2・4・6・7・8回 and Git basics, and the text recalls them where it relies on them (「Manualモード（第2回）」, 「MCPサーバー（第8回）」, 「CLAUDE.mdと同じく」). Most terms are explained on first use (トークン, PR, シェル, API). But s4-table uses 「GitHub Actions」 without saying what it is, and e3 uses `bypassPermissions` with no pointer to 第2回.

measure.mjs gives 「prose 2262 (budget 1,200–2,400) … est 20.0 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 20)」 and lint --strict is clean, so the lesson is within budget but at the cap. Every section has a list, code or check, and no section adds more than 3 new terms. The headless section is the densest: 非対話的実行, フラグ and シェル plus five flags, though s3-table explains each flag in one line.

s2-steps is a 5-step worked example. Each step has a subgoal title and a reason (「ワークツリーは既存のコミットから作ります」, 「消すとブランチも消えます」), and comes before any practice. s3-code with s3-table and s4-prompt (「4点との対応：…」) model the command and the prompt before practice-command and practice-audit. There is no faded example between the worked example and independent practice.

There are inline checks in 4 of the 5 segments (q1, q2, q3, q4), and two segments never pass in a row without one. They are apply or analyze items in new situations, such as diagnosing 「モジュールが見つからない」 in q2 and a bare `claude -p` in nightly CI in q3. Every wrong option has feedback, and every question has a hint.

All 7 misconceptions in the brief are corrected with a reason: same-folder sessions (q0), missing dependencies (q2), -p auto/wait/allow-all (q3 b/c/d), 「Bash」 too broad (s3-pitfall, e3), -p trust (e4 d), the prompt not being enforced (s4-enforce, e6), and a quiet day vs a failed read (q4 d, e5). Each feedback is 2 sentences or fewer and names the specific mistake.

There are no images or diagrams, so nothing is decorative. The worktree layout is described in s2-code and in the ex-feature expect (「`.claude/worktrees/` の下に、フォルダーが2つ…ブランチ `worktree-feature-a` と `worktree-bugfix-b`」). That is enough without a figure, though a small diagram would help.

Both practices are hands-on and safe: a nightly claude -p in `cc-practice-09`, and an audit of a weak prompt. Each moves from hint to troubleshoot to a model answer (p1-model, the p2-prompt expect) and has a checklist (p1-checklist, p2-checklist), and p-run asks the learner to predict first. p2-before reuses the nightly-test task from practice 1, so neither practice is a transfer task.

The summary section comes after the exam. It has 4 takeaways (summary-points), a reflection task (「毎日くり返す確認を1つ選び…成功の条件を1文で」), the next lesson (「第10回｜安全とコストを管理する」), 7 flashcards and askTutor suggestions.

The three confirmed findings in audit-cc-09-parallel-automation.json are fixed in the current text. s1-lead now says 「並列の道具を2つ紹介します」. s3-table says 「確認が要る操作を聞かずに拒否します（読み取りは動きます）」, and e3, pc-mode and p2-prompt use the same wording. summary-points says 「モードを指定しない `claude -p` は、v2.1.302から…」. The other claims checked against the cached official pages also hold: the 1-hour and 1-minute minimums, 3–5 times a normal run, `Failed to resolve base branch`, and removing a worktree also deleting its branch. The version is pinned to v2.1.304. One citation does not cover its claim: s4-enforce cites only cc-headless for the claim that CLAUDE.md is not enforced.

The text is consistently です・ます and non-pressuring (「名前だけで十分です」, 「大事なリポジトリでは試しません」), with no banned phrases (lint clean). Katakana terms carry English on first use (ワークツリー（worktree）, フラグ（flag）). A few lines are clipped, such as 「準備：コミットと信頼」 and 「消すとブランチも消えます」. The ja-editor owns the wording.

The lesson is jp only and complete, with no images and so no missing alt text. The one link has descriptive text (「公式ドキュメント（非対話的実行）」). Plain-text fields such as checklist labels contain no markdown (「--bare を付けています…」), so they render cleanly.

niceToHave: s4-enforce citation: cc-headless does not say that CLAUDE.md is not enforced (in headless.md, 'enforce' appears only for json-schema `format`). Add the source {"id": "cc-memory", "title": "How Claude remembers your project", "url": "https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory", "publisher": "Anthropic", "checkedAt": "2026-10-20"}, already used by cc-06, which says 'Claude treats CLAUDE.md files as context, not enforced configuration'. Then set s4-enforce cite to ["cc-headless", "cc-memory"].

s4-enforce wording: as written, a learner may decide that the 「編集しない」 line is pointless, yet s4-prompt and the e5 key both keep it. Suggested text: 「依頼文の「編集しない」も書きますが、CLAUDE.mdと同じく強制にはなりません。」 (the ja-editor decides the wording).

section parallel: the title 「1. 並列の3つの方法を選び分ける」 conflicts with s1-lead 「並列の道具を2つ紹介します」, and the agents page lists neither worktrees nor background bash among its five ways. Suggested title: 「1. 作業に合わせて並べ方を選ぶ」.
s4-table item 1: GitHub Actions is used without saying what it is. Suggested text: 「PR（プルリクエスト）や決まった時刻にCIで動かすなら、GitHub Actions（GitHubのCI）を使います。」
check-quiz e3: add a short pointer for the term from the earlier lesson, e.g. in option b feedback 「`Bash` は全コマンドを通し、`bypassPermissions`（第2回）は確認を飛ばします。」

unattended-where (s4-table) is not covered by any objective, question or practice, so for this lesson it is extra load (est is at the 20.0 cap). Either shorten it to one sentence, e.g. 「無人の作業は、GitHub Actions、[[定期タスク]]（クラウドの `/schedule` やデスクトップ）、`/loop` で動かせます。」, or add an o3 exam item that makes the learner pick where to run a given task, cutting an equal amount elsewhere.

o3 is a create objective, but every o3 question asks the learner to analyze or choose. Consider changing e5 into an item where the learner picks the missing line to add to a partly written prompt, or change o3's verb and bloom to 「点検して直せる」 / evaluate so the objective matches what is assessed.

practice-audit p2-before reuses the nightly-test task from practice 1, so it is not a transfer task. Consider 「毎朝ログを見て、エラーをいい感じにまとめておいて。原因がわかったら直しておいて。」 and update the model answer in the p2-prompt expect to match.
p2-prompt: rename the variable to 「直した依頼文とコマンド」 so that Claude can also check point 3 (--max-budget-usd) and the permission flags the prompt asks about.
s2-steps ex-feature: the learner is never told what to ask each worktree session. If the budget allows, add a line such as 「機能Aには「a.txt を追加して」、バグ修正Bには「b.txt を追加して」と頼みます。」

factual doubt: e2 says the dev server keeps Claude 「止まったまま」. interactive-mode.md says a command that reaches its timeout is moved to the background automatically. Suggested stem: 「…コマンドが終わらず、Claudeの作業がしばらく止まっています。」
The brief puts 「終了コード」 in scope for 非対話的実行, but the lesson never mentions exit codes. Either move it to the brief's out-of-scope list or add one sentence to s3-table.

Optional: a 4–5 node diagram (main checkout → .claude/worktrees/feature-a and bugfix-b on branches worktree-* → git merge), with caption and alt, would support s2-steps. Make an equal cut, because est is at the cap.
summary: Full review of an unchanged lesson. Its biggest strength is misconception coverage: all seven misconceptions in the brief are carried by specific wrong options or a pitfall, and each is corrected with a reason. The worked examples (s2-steps, s3-code with s3-table, s4-prompt) come before practice that has checklists and model answers. The audited accuracy fixes are in place and there is no open must-fix. The most useful improvements would make section 4 pay its way or shrink it, measure o3 at the create level, and add the cc-memory citation to s4-enforce.
